summary.title: Generation Scotland — 2015 Genotyping
summary.abstract: Generation Scotland (Scottish Family Health Study) is an intensively phenotyped, family-based cohort for the study of the genetic basis of common complex diseases and response to treatments. This record covers the 2015 genotyping: DNA from over 20,000 GS:SFHS participants analysed by high-density genome-wide chip genotyping (Illumina OmniExpress SNP GWAS, 700k) and exome chip (250K).
summary.description: Genome-wide genotyping (Illumina OmniExpress 700k, exome chip 250k) carried out in 2015 on DNA extracted from blood/saliva samples collected during the main Generation Scotland recruitment (2006-2011). QC included population stratification analysis and imputation to the 1000 Genomes dataset.

recruitment.samplingMethod: Recruited via participating family members, primarily through general practices across Scotland.

followUpSchedule.note: Participants are not re-contacted on a schedule. Ongoing information comes from linked administrative and health records.

eligibility.inclusionCriteria: Adults (18+) with at least one first-degree relative also willing to participate.
